section: GreenCart Retail Pvt. Ltd.: Business Plan 2026-2028
sentence: All names and numbers are invented.
GreenCart Retail runs 22 grocery stores across Gujarat and Rajasthan.
In 2025 the company recorded sales of Rs. 118 crore and a net margin of 3.4%.
The management plans to open 12 new stores by the end of 2027.
The company opened four stores last year.
About 18% of our packaged goods are imported.
We assume the exchange rate will remain close to INR 83 per USD during the planning period.
A move above INR 88 per USD would raise import costs by roughly 6%.
Management discussed hedging options yesterday.
Delivery vans use diesel, and transport is 11% of operating cost.
We expect diesel prices to stay below Rs. 95 per litre throughout 2026.
The company does not currently hedge fuel costs.
Supplier contracts are renewed every March.
Household spending on groceries is expected to grow by 8% next year.
We assume customer footfall will rise by 5% per year in existing stores.
Online orders are projected to reach 15% of sales by 2028.
The company serves about 40,000 customers each month.
The proposed term loan carries an interest rate of 10.2%, and we do not expect it to change by more than 1 percentage point.
Store staff wages are assumed to rise by 7% per year.
The company employs 640 people.
The table below shows the base-case projection in Rs. crore.
We assume freight and store rents will rise by 5% per year.
We expect regulatory changes on food labeling to have only a minor effect before 2028.
Sales are projected to reach Rs. 170 crore by 2028.
The largest risk is a sharp rise in import costs.
A second risk is the loss of a key supplier.
Management reviews the plan every quarter.
